sources.title: Adult social care priorities for local authorities: 2026 to 2027
sources.publisher: Department of Health and Social Care
sources.verified_claim: DHSC sets three 2026-27 priority outcomes around quality and workforce, independence and choice, and neighbourhood-level integration. National priorities guide local planning but do not establish care capacity at any sample parcel.

sources.title: Annex A - list of priority outcomes and expectations for local authorities: 2026 to 2027
sources.publisher: Department of Health and Social Care
sources.verified_claim: Annex A expects sustainable commissioning, appropriate fee rates, workforce capacity and joined-up services. These are authority-level expectations rather than proof of provider headroom near a sample parcel.

sources.title: Annex C - metrics and data for 2026 to 2027
sources.publisher: Department of Health and Social Care
sources.verified_claim: Annex C defines access, workforce turnover, satisfaction, safeguarding, direct-payment and experimental waiting-time metrics. Authority-level metrics require local data and cannot be converted into parcel-level care capacity.

sources.title: Local government finance policy statement 2026-27 to 2028-29
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The statement consolidates several adult-social-care grants into wider local-government funding from 2026-27 and describes notional allocations as reference points rather than formal spend requirements. Funding architecture is not parcel capacity.

sources.title: Enfield Council’s adult social care rated ‘Good’ by regulator
sources.verified_claim: Enfield reports a CQC Good rating and strengths in independence, reablement and partnership working. A quality assessment of the authority does not establish provider availability or capacity at parcel_30762.

sources.title: Market shaping
sources.verified_claim: Havering's provider hub describes its Market Position Statement as setting the direction of travel, future needs, current market and commissioning intentions. Market-shaping evidence does not confirm capacity for parcel_46142.

sources.title: Lambeth Market Position Statement 2023-28
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's Market Position Statement describes current care-support markets, projected future needs and commissioning intentions and notes periodic refreshes. It is borough market evidence rather than exact parcel service headroom.

sources.title: Professionals and care providers
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's current provider page links commissioning, the Market Position Statement and Market Sustainability and Improvement Fund work. Commissioning infrastructure does not prove available care capacity at parcel_61522.
